title: MP State Disaster Management Helpline 1070 / 1079
department: Home Department / MP State Disaster Management Authority
eligibility: Citizens facing natural disasters (floods, earthquakes, industrial hazards) in MP
benefits: Immediate alert dispatch to State Disaster Response Force (SDRF)
Evacuation coordination and emergency shelter assistance
application_process: Step 1: Dial 1070 (State Level) or 1077 (District Collectorate Control Room)
Step 2: Provide precise disaster location details
